context: Two friends discuss a TV drama they recorded
purpose: Teach: 警備/中継/看護/録画/残す/時には/次第に/観る

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 昨日の医療ドラマ、ちゃんと録画できてた？
lines.en: Did yesterday's medical drama record properly?
lines.style: Soft opening question between close friends.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、録画予約してたから安心して観られるよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I set the recording, so we can watch it without worry.
lines.style: Cheerful reassurance from a tech-savvy teen confirming everything went well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: よかった〜。看護師さんのシーン、絶対泣けるって聞いたの。
lines.en: Thank goodness. I heard the nurse's scene is a total tearjerker.
lines.style: Romantic anticipation with emotional emphasis., tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: あー、病院の警備員のおじさんが主役を助ける回でしょ？
lines.en: Oh, the episode where the hospital security guard saves the lead, right?
lines.style: Excited teenage recall of specific plot details from memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: そうそう。あの俳優さん、サッカーの中継にも出てたよね。
lines.en: Right, that actor was on a soccer broadcast too, wasn't he?
lines.style: Light celebrity trivia, dreamy tone., delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 時には恋愛、時にはミステリーって感じで飽きないんだよね。
lines.en: Sometimes romance, sometimes mystery — it never gets boring.
lines.style: Animated genre appreciation from an enthusiastic fan of the show.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 次第に登場人物に感情移入しちゃって、もう止まらないの。
lines.en: I gradually got attached to the characters and now I can't stop.
lines.style: Heartfelt confession of binge-watching the whole series obsessively.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今夜一緒に観る？ハードディスクに残すかどうかも決めよ。
lines.en: Wanna watch together tonight? We can decide whether to keep it on the drive too.
lines.style: Friendly invitation with practical follow-up., spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
